text: ProgramIntroduction The aims of the Undergraduate (Bachelor Degree) Program of Logistics Engineering are cultivating international, commercial and engineering specialists in Logistics Management and Engineering who are skilled with the basic theory and fundamental knowledge o f management, economics, statistics and information, can be engaged in international logistics management, analysis of enterprise logistics management simulation and optimization, logistics information system design and development, logistics system planning and design. Logistics engineering requires students to master the basic skills such as foreign language, computer information, statistics, modern enterprise logistics management and logistics internationalization management. Main Courses The program has been developed in response to the increasing complexity and diversity of logistics engineering. The program is focused on computer technology, logistics engineering and management by 3 modules (the list below is a part of the all courses): MODULE I.Computer technology The Principle of Database Java Program Design Web Technology E- commerce System Design and Implementation MODULE II.Logistics Engineering Distribution Center Warehouse Management and Inventory Control Transportation Engineering Logistics Information System Logistics System Planning and Design MODULE III Management Marketing Eeconomics International trade BusinessEnglish Economics Law Transportation Law Transportation engineering Advanced Mathematics Business administration Duration 4 years Degree Awarded With necessary credits, those who have passed all the required courses and met the requirements for graduation of the university will be awardedbachelor's degree and diploma. Career Opportunity Graduates can be engaged injobs relating tointernationallogistics management, analysis of enterprise logistics management simulation and optimization, logisticsinformation system design and development, logistics system planning and design.They can join the logistic department of big manufacturing companies , corporations specilized in logistics, business organizations, e-commerce companies and so on. They can also choose to further their study in a master degree course. Notes: Program commences only if 15 students are enrolled ; otherwise you can study Chinese Language/ Pre- University Program/ other bachelor programs.
